theme_strategy.rationale: For an opportunity search engine serving millions of Pakistani youth, professionals, and students, absolute legibility, high contrast, fast loading, and authoritative trust are essential.

primary.description: Deep Emerald Navy - Trustworthy, authoritative primary shade

secondary.description: Electric Blue - Actionable secondary shade for key interactive elements

accent_emerald.description: Pakistani Sovereign Emerald - Used for verified badges, government opportunities, success states

accent_gold.description: Urgent Warning Amber - Closing Soon badges and high-priority deadline callouts

text_muted.description: Muted slate for secondary metadata and subheadings

border_subtle.description: Crisp 1px border stroke for cardless/bento layouts

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.badge: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full

grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Asymmetric bento grid with high-impact quick search card, live opportunity counter ticker, and quick category pills
grids_and_layouts.opportunity_feed: Responsive bento grid (1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet, 3 cols desktop) with strict padding (p-5 sm:p-6), clear visual badges, and hover lift effects
grids_and_layouts.detail_layout: 2-column layout with 8-col main content (description, eligibility, application steps) and 4-col sticky quick-facts widget (deadline countdown, salary/stipend, organization logo, direct verified source CTA)
grids_and_layouts.filter_drawer_and_sidebar: Sticky left or top filter bar with real-time reactive filters and clear-all triggers

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60
visual_enhancers.card_borders: border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 transition-all duration-200

badges.government: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200 border dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800
badges.private: bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200 border dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800
badges.scholarship: bg-purple-50 text-purple-800 border-purple-200 border dark:bg-purple-950/50 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800
badges.closing_soon: bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200 border dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800
badges.remote: bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 border-teal-200 border dark:bg-teal-950/50 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-800

ad_slots_placeholders.strategy: Dedicated AdSlot components (AdSlotTop, AdSlotBetweenContent, AdSlotSidebar, AdSlotInContent, AdSlotBottom) with subtle dashed boundaries, clear sponsor disclaimer, and toggle switch to preview live or empty state.

component_name.Header: Header containing brand logo PAKOPPS, quick search shortcut, primary nav links, and theme toggle button
component_name.HeroSection: Hero banner with Pakistan-focused tagline, big search bar with instant autocomplete, filter chips, and live opportunity counters
component_name.OpportunityCard: Card displaying opportunity status, title, organization, location badge, deadline countdown, verification stamp, and View Details button
component_name.OpportunityDetail: Comprehensive verification page showing official notification source, detailed eligibility, salary/stipend, syllabus/test details, and official apply link
component_name.AdvancedSearch: Powerful filter component supporting category, province/city, education qualification, job type, salary range, closing soon, and sorting
component_name.AdSlot: AdSlot component supporting top, inline, sidebar, between content, and footer positions with toggle for placeholder view
component_name.TrustPages: Pages covering Editorial Policy, Source Verification Method, How It Works, Disclaimer, Terms, Privacy, and Report Opportunity Form
component_name.ResourceCenter: Career guides, resume tips, entry test preparation links, and scholarship application step-by-step guides
component_name.Footer: SEO-rich multi-column footer with province/city directory links, popular categories, trust badges, and copyright statement

motion.transitions: Smooth scale on button press (whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}), subtle hover elevation (whileHover={{ y: -2 }}), staggered list entrance
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion useReducedMotion

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA adherence across all badges and interactive states
accessibility.mobile_touch_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px for buttons, tags, and inputs

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='opportunity-card-1', data-testid='apply-official-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Note that files in this project use standard React JavaScript (.js and .jsx extensions, NOT .tsx). Ensure imports and exports follow JS syntax.
Implement PAKOPPS as a completely PUBLIC search engine and directory — NO login, NO registration, NO user dashboard, NO admin panel required.

Ensure AdSlot components (AdSlotTop, AdSlotBetweenContent, AdSlotSidebar, AdSlotInContent, AdSlotBottom) are strategically rendered but rendered as elegant disabled placeholders or subtle sponsor cards with full AdSense structure.

Include realistic mock dataset of 50+ Pakistani and International opportunities covering Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC), Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC), Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), HEC Scholarships, Fulbright, Commonwealth, Tech Remote Jobs, Bank Jobs, Engineering Apprenticeships, and Medical Admissions.

Ensure every opportunity card has clear badges: Government/Private, Full-time/Remote, Qualification requirement (Matric, Inter, Bachelors, Masters, PhD), City/Province, and Deadline with color-coded urgency.
Add 'Report an Opportunity' modal or page to report expired or inaccurate listings, reinforcing trust.
Provide a dedicated SEO-friendly URL structure or view state for categories (e.g. /government-jobs, /scholarships, /remote-jobs) and detail views.
Include every data-testid on interactive elements for reliable end-to-end testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not build generic single-column job boards. Use high-density bento grids, crisp typography, custom status badges, and authentic trust indicators.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions_rule: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Specify explicit properties such as transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_align_app: Never apply text-align: center on the main app container. Keep left-aligned natural reading flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_hover: Hover states must explicitly declare text color and background color to avoid invisible text on hover.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_emojis: Use lucide-react icons instead of emojis for icons or indicators.
